text: Proposal for webhook idempotency: store an idempotency key per Stripe event in Redis with a 24h TTL. Stripe retries webhooks for up to 24 hours, so after that the key is useless.
Why not keep keys forever in ledger-db?
That table would grow by millions of rows a month, and Redis lookups are ~1ms on the hot path. 24h covers the whole retry window.
Makes sense. Let's go with 24h TTL in Redis. We'll document it later.
Yes, every webhook type goes through the same check.
